question: Joint hidden source-observed event probability and future RUL under sparse/delayed health arrival; test exact no-report transport and shared-state value against strong simple baselines.

scope.source_event: first valid original RPT Q<=0.20Ah at stop, not latent physical EOL
scope.cohort: frozen C1/C2 train125,C3 dev63,C4 locked63 payload0
scope.noT: current source-event label0 only within recorded source window; future RUL None/masked; never independent censoring

queries.anchor: second valid RPT without T selection
queries.grid: every valid source RPT stop>=anchor+7days to recorded end inclusive
queries.common: all arms at least3arrived observations; original source-index parity for sparse2; source/arrival/query preserved
queries.features: old74causal features at query q and same visible history at a=max(arrival)<=q; query delta only analytic for transported models
queries.known_event: any retained arrived health Q<=0.20 => all models RUL0,p1; no negative survival oracle

distribution.neural: zero atom plus16uniform interval masses plus1exponential tail; exact CDF/quantile/positive-part mean
distribution.transport: R_q=max(R_a-(q-a),0); p(q)=F_a(q-a), no survival conditioning; update history only on actual arrivals
distribution.hgb: empirical distributions preserve full support; hurdle zero atom plus positive empirical residual distribution

models.hgb_hurdle: current event HGBClassifier1fit plus future-positive logRUL HGB2OOF+full3fits=4/seed
models.risk_query: standard discrete hazard MLP query features,48x2 SiLU
models.dart_split: separate32x2 p/future networks,same anchor distribution family/loss/transport; actual parameter counts reported

loss.weight: each cell total1, same common queries/3arms within cell equal; totalweight=#cells retains original HGB l2 scaling; neural weighted loss divides by weight sum
loss.known_future: joint positive R_q density at true positive RUL; no extra double-counted BCE
loss.past_event: -log F_anchor(delta), or current event atom for query models
loss.noT: -log(1-F_anchor(delta)) current state only; no future loss
loss.hgb: cell-weighted event logloss; future regression positive knownT only; complete-event EOL baseline uses knownT; report event-selection limitation
loss.scale: train-only; no dev calibration,checkpoint selection,hyperparameter search

evaluation.primary: cell-equal instantaneous event Brier on unconfirmed queries pooled sparse2+delay7d; all-window separately
evaluation.probability: cell-weighted fixed10-bin ECE, reliability counts, horizon4/12 Brier only legally observed labels, noT future masked
evaluation.RUL: mean/median MAE,>4week severe overprediction,IS80/coverage, common-bin logscore retaining zero-probability infinities
evaluation.update: all-arrival/no-new-report consistency and arrival change panel, no T-based selection
evaluation.failure: invalid model/rows retained; no seed deletion/rescue
evaluation.summary: each seed plus mean and per-cell paired bootstrap; no dev scores called independent

selection.stronger_ref_rule: also compare strongest prespecified simple fullwindow HGB under same primary score, report either
selection.development_gate: mean across3seeds>=5% lower unconfirmed sparse+delay Brier vs strongest simple HGB; no arm severe overprediction+>1percentagepoint; knownT MAE not worse>2%; candidate must beat query-risk, no-transport and split-state on mechanism readouts to support mechanism claim
selection.frozen_C4: separate once-only confirmation only after all method,weights,metric,selection frozen and freshGO; current GO never includes C4
selection.novelty: probability decomposition/transport/zero atom/hazard alone not novelty; require competitor-reviewed mechanism and gains
